rootPointDispositions.assessment: Agreed and independently measured on UCD 15.0.0: U+0130 -> U+0069 U+0307, OS -> os with final sigma, sharp s unchanged where casefold gives ss. My v1 'simple lowercase' wording was wrong in a way that would change an admission outcome.
rootPointDispositions.correction: lib_name_fold names the operation (full, non-tailored, context-sensitive Default Case Conversion toLowercase(X)), is used at all three former .lower() sites, and GATES on UNICODE_CASE_DATA_VERSION, raising a distinct ReferenceEnvironmentError - never an AdmissionError - when the declared case data is absent. Section 2.4 publishes the discriminator table and the version custody.
rootPointDispositions.portabilityConsequenceStatedNotHidden: Making the binding effective means this reference derivation refuses to run where the declared Unicode case data is absent. That is a real restriction and it is published in both the prose and the docstring; the alternative was a declared version nothing consults beside a fold that silently returns a different answer.
